pins.recorded_excerpt: CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md; nested CLAUDE.md loads on demand; AGENTS.md may stand in for CLAUDE.md; keep instructions concise, ideally under 200 lines. Hooks enforce; instructions are context.

Discovers AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md from the user dir then the repo root down to cwd; closer files come later and override; project_doc_max_bytes default is 32768; trusted projects use .codex/config.toml.
Default context file is GEMINI.md. Hierarchy is ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md then the workspace. context.fileName may be a string or array. context.discoveryMaxDirs default is 200.
AGENTS.md at the root and in subdirectories; the nested file applies in that tree. Project Rules are .cursor/rules/*.mdc. Plain .md in that folder is ignored.
Loads AGENTS.md and compatible CLAUDE.md. Deeper files take precedence. Project hooks live in .grok/hooks/*.json.
No required headings. The closest AGENTS.md to the edited file wins. User chat overrides. Pin d001185d792eb6402a58e4cbef1c228b309ec25d.

hook_events.blocks: Exit 2 blocks. JSON decision block is also a deny. PermissionRequest, Elicitation, and ElicitationResult are not auto-approved.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: Each event corresponds to a point in Claude Code’s lifecycle where hooks can run.

hook_events.blocks: PreToolUse uses permissionDecision deny. Exit 2 blocks where the CLI honors it. PostToolUseFailure is not an official Codex event.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: Hooks are an extensibility framework for Codex.

hook_events.blocks: Exit code 0 allows, exit code 2 denies. Everything else is fail-open. HostCapability.process_exit2_honored stays false until a live probe.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: Exit code 0 allows, exit code 2 denies. Everything else — timeouts, crashes, malformed output — is fail-open: the failure is recorded in the session but the tool call proceeds.

hook_events.blocks: BeforeTool can block with a JSON decision. Exit 2 is the ChaosEngine deny code.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: Hooks are triggered by specific events in Gemini CLI’s lifecycle.

hook_events.blocks: preToolUse can deny with permissionDecision. Exit 2 is not a proven process block.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: GitHub Copilot hook events include sessionStart, userPromptSubmitted, preToolUse, postToolUse, postToolUseFailure, agentStop, subagentStop, preCompact, and sessionEnd. Names are camelCase. A crash fails open.

hook_events.blocks: preToolUse deny is permission deny. beforeSubmitPrompt deny is continue false. stop and subagentStop use followup_message. Exit 2 blocks unless failClosed is unset and the exit is something else, in which case the default is fail-open. failClosed is true only for preToolUse in ChaosEngine.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: Cursor agent hooks include sessionStart, beforeSubmitPrompt, preToolUse, postToolUse, postToolUseFailure, subagentStart, subagentStop, stop, preCompact, and sessionEnd. Exit 0 uses JSON. Exit 2 blocks. Other exits fail open unless failClosed is true. sessionStart can return additional_context. stop can return followup_message.

hook_events.blocks: tool.execute.before and execute.before throw to deny. After hooks observe. session.idle does not block. session.created has no documented context channel.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: OpenCode plugin hooks include tool.execute.before, execute.before, tool.execute.after, execute.after, session.created, and session.idle. A throw from the before hook denies the tool. session.created has no documented context channel. session.idle is observe-only.

hook_events.blocks: PreToolUse deny is JSON decision deny on exit 0. Stop decision continue keeps working. Any non-zero exit fails open. PreToolUse and PostToolUse use matcher groups. SessionStart, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, and Stop use flat arrays.
hook_events.recorded_excerpt: Antigravity hook events are SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, and Stop. PreToolUse and PostToolUse take matcher groups. SessionStart, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, and Stop take flat arrays. Blocking is JSON on exit 0. Any non-zero exit fails open.
